# aibris v0.8.3

This release tightens the agreement between `scan` and `clean` and makes
agent-state scanning cheaper. The safety contract is unchanged.

## Highlights

- `scan`'s `default clean` figure is now an explicit estimate that applies the
  same existence filtering and target normalization `clean` uses before
  planning. Eligible targets nested inside another eligible target (for
  example `node_modules` inside an orphaned worktree) are counted once instead
  of twice, and targets removed between scan and clean stay excluded in both
  commands. Run `aibris clean --dry-run` for the exact plan.
- Claude and Cursor agent-state scans now size every project-store entry with
  one batched `du` call instead of one directory walk per entry, matching the
  existing `node_modules` and worktree sizing path.

## Notes

- On Unix, agent-state sizes are now physical (block-rounded) bytes,
  consistent with `node_modules` and worktree sizes; item counts and
  classifications are unchanged. Windows keeps the walk-based fallback.
- No eligibility rules, protections, or default policy changed.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sungjunlee/aibris/blob/v0.8.3/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete curated change list.
